research_goal: Verifier reliability across generator updates; no assumed generator improvement

prompts.G_system: Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}.
prompts.G_user_suffix: Give a complete solution. End with exactly one final answer in \boxed{...}. Use the mathematical form requested in the question. Do not add another answer after the box.
prompts.V_system: Judge whether the FINAL ANSWER in the candidate response correctly answers the question. Work out the answer independently. A means the final answer is correct; B means it is incorrect. Judge final-answer correctness, not the completeness of the explanation. Respond with exactly A or B.

G_output_budget_rule: min(3840,4096 - exact rendered prompt token count); same rule and tokenizer for G0/G1/G2

G.sample_selection: pilot.day3_protocol.select_feedback; whole invalid questions excluded; one random V0-accepted response per question; unknown answer labels do not filter selections; cap512 without duplicating rows
G.quality_reporting: For each actual A selection, separately report correct/wrong/unknown and bounds after selection; never silently filter by truth.
G.truncation: Never truncate tensors; reject over-context examples, log IDs/reasons; generation-truncated answers excluded by fixed structural rule.

V_smoke.purpose: day3 engineering smoke only; adapters never become G1/G2/Vrand/Vtarget

V_smoke.V_selection: Development only;8 natural independently labelled correct+8 wrong, one longest fitting example per label plus7 seeded-shuffled examples with distinct questions within each label; interleave A/B; no source-unresolved or unknown labels.

Supplements remain separate from main C and actual16-example smoke selection.
